package.description: A small, fast, native desktop video downloader built on yt-dlp.

en-US.description: A small, fast, native desktop video downloader built on yt-dlp.
en-US.longDescription:
Snag is a native desktop front end for yt-dlp, written in Rust with no webview
and no bundled runtime. Paste a link, choose whether you want video with audio,
audio only, or video with the audio dropped, and it downloads.

It also remuxes files you already have: change container, extract audio, mute,
or convert to GIF, all through ffmpeg.

Restricted YouTube videos work too. Snag has no login form and never asks for
a password: you sign in to YouTube in your own browser, pick that browser, and
Snag borrows the session for YouTube links only.

Snag does not ship yt-dlp. On first launch it offers to download the current
release from the yt-dlp project's own GitHub releases, and keeps it updated for
you. It also finds ffmpeg, which merging and converting need, or installs it
for you through winget (Gyan.FFmpeg).
en-US.name: Snag
